_meta.purpose: Paradiso 필수서류 작성 도우미 — official-form overlay coordinates + field inventory
_meta.privacy: All values are filled in the browser and written onto a locally-fetched blank PDF in memory. No personal data is transmitted to or stored by any server; nothing is saved to localStorage.
_meta.disclaimer: 참고용 초안 작성 도구입니다. 법적 효력·허가를 보장하지 않으며 제출을 대행하지 않습니다.
_meta.coordSystem: PDF points. Origin top-left, y is the text BASELINE (PyMuPDF convention). For pdf-lib (origin bottom-left) convert: y_pdf = pageHeight - y. check = vector tick centred at (cx,cy); wbox = white-out rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] drawn before text; digits = one digit centred in each printed cell when the value has exactly that many digits; maxWidth = printed cell width available for the text (fit: shrink to the 6.5pt floor, wrap when lines>1, otherwise flagged as overflow); align=center draws the text centred on x; page = 0-based page index.
